Disappointing Samsung S5... No premium look... Performance issues... Only HSDPA+ speed.... First of all, I returned this Galaxy S5 because it came defective (display issues and charger not working properly), but I was able to try the S5 for a few days... I don't understand that the S5 has lag issues, I had performance issues while I was playing REAL RACING 3, frame rate dropping... Which I can only think is the samsung bloatwares installed... Even though, with the Exyon Quad Core; 1.9GHz,1.3GHz (8 cores CPU), the S5 must have been running very smoothly... The camera is not good in low light conditions... Which is crazy... The heart beat scanner is silly, because it's gimmicky, it takes more battery life and nothing more... Also, the Heart beat scanner brings inconsistent readings all the time... I am very disappointed for a device that cost more than $600 not having a premium look and performance...

The only thing I do not like about the display is that it is not very bright. If you are under direct sunlight you have to increase the brightness all the way up in order to distinguish anything. Even then videos are very difficult to watch under sunlight. PERFORMANCE The Galaxy S5 comes with a Qualcomm Snapdragon 801 processor and 2 GB of Ram. This phone comes with latest version of android which is Kit Kat 4.4.2. This is the most secure, stable, and smooth version of android. The processor makes the phone feel fast and the phone can handle just about everything that you throw at it. With this phone you don’t have to worry about how many applications you have opened or whether or not it is going to freeze. Samsung has been refining and perfecting multitasking the last few years.

Time Keeper 75. For 'the next big thing' it's a piece of junk. We've had our Galaxy S5s for six months and here is the list of problems: 1. With only 14 apps on this phone, it constantly overheats. At least once a day. 2. When tech support took it, they found nothing wrong with the phone but replaced the battery as a precaution but the overheating continues. 3. When tilting the video screen from vertical to horizontal, the delay is ridiculous compared to an Apple product. 4. When texting, opening, reading and sending texts, the phone cannot keep up with my typing. 5. Autocorrect. Who doesn't have problems with autocorrect? This one changes thing from 'texting' to 'text NH'. Simple, simple words are horribly misconstrued. 6. Regarding other apps, all I have to say is the Galaxy S5 simply has VERY SLOW PROCESSING SPEED. It is ridiculously slow.

Samsung Galaxy S5 - Read the reviews before you purchase. I purchased this phone in May 2014, worked ok after I got on the phone with my carrier, the reception is bad (very Bad) I had to activate my airave in order for it to work in my home. In July the phone started freezing up, turning off on it's own, had to take out the battery for it to come back on only for a short period of time. Finally I took it to my carrier and they told me that I had too many apps (beloney), because I had the same apps on my Samsung Galaxy s3. After trips to the repair center, many, many, too Many phone conversations, they my carrier will be sending me a new phone. On the other hand when the phone "Worked" I did like it and hope the new one works fine!
